note: Phase 18 (BPMN e2e retirement, plan §5.3/§21.3) retargeted tests/e2e/lite-mandatory-translation.spec.ts from the deleted bpmn-js Lite shell to the ARIS shell; all 6 tests were rewritten (none of the old mechanisms survived — they were 100% BPMN-shell-specific) but all 10 requirement ids retain at least partial genuine coverage on real, currently-reachable ARIS surfaces (AML import via the details rail's bilingual editor, the derived-AML export/reimport round trip, the AI generation panel, and the chat gap-completion batch). Two mechanisms found dead by reading source (grep confirmed neither is imported anywhere reachable from ArisApp.tsx or src/aris/**) and reflected as narrowed coverage below rather than silently dropped: (1) the old per-field machine-translation review dialog (src/localization/TranslationReviewDialog.tsx and the rest of src/localization/**, plus the workspace translation-memory JSON persistence) — TR-06's 'manual edit' clause and TR-05's 'source Apply'/'backup' clauses have no ARIS equivalent; (2) free-text annotation bilingual editing — ArisDetailsElement's kind union (src/aris/details/seam.ts) has no 'freeText' case, so TR-04's 'annotations' clause is satisfied instead via a rule object's bilingual name/attribute, a real but narrower analogue.
